info.name: Cricketer Management API - CRUD Tests
info.description: Postman tests for the Cricketer Management REST API (Express + SQLite).

exec: pm.test("TC01: status code is 201", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test("TC01: response is JSON", function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });
const body = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("id", body.id);

pm.test("TC01: response contains generated id and same data", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.name).to.eql('Babar Azam'); pm.expect(body.jerseyNo).to.eql(56); });
pm.test("TC02: status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("TC02: response is JSON", function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });

pm.test("TC02: returns an array containing the created record", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.map(x => x.id)).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('id'))); });

item.name: TC03 - Retrieve a single cricketer by id

exec: pm.test("TC03: status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("TC03: response is JSON", function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });

pm.test("TC03: returns the requested record", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('id'))); pm.expect(body.team).to.eql('Pakistan'); });
pm.test("TC04: status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("TC04: response is JSON", function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });
pm.test("TC04: returned data shows the updated values", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.matches).to.eql(125); pm.expect(body.runs).to.eql(5400); });

item.name: TC06 - Create with required fields missing

exec: pm.test("TC06: status code is 400", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test("TC06: response is JSON", function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });

pm.test("TC06: error lists name, team and role problems", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.error).to.eql('Validation failed'); pm.expect(body.details.length).to.be.at.least(3); });

item.name: TC07 - Create with invalid role and negative runs

exec: pm.test("TC07: status code is 400", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test("TC07: response is JSON", function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });
pm.test("TC07: error mentions role and runs", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); const t = body.details.join(' '); pm.expect(t).to.include('role'); pm.expect(t).to.include('runs'); });
